title: Find the hidden nutmeg
brief: The scaled-up cookie recipe has a secret ingredient hidden among the steps. Search for 'nutmeg' and change it to 'cardamom'.
text:
Mix flour and sugar.
Fold in butter.
Sprinkle nutmeg evenly.
Bake at 180C for 15 min.

expect.text:
Mix flour and sugar.
Fold in butter.
Sprinkle cardamom evenly.
Bake at 180C for 15 min.

why: Searching with / jumps directly to the target word. Once there, ciw changes the whole word under the cursor so you can type the replacement immediately.
author: claude (daily)
hint: Search with /, then use change-inner-word to replace what you found.
